input_fields.name: body_reference
input_fields.description: One current body reference whose faces are to be enumerated.

result_fields.name: face_collection
result_fields.description: All current faces owned by body_reference.

result_fields.name: body_binding
result_fields.description: Body identity and ownership check proving no other body was mixed in.

procedure: Resolve body_reference and verify its current ownership before enumeration.
Read the body's current face collection once and preserve each face identity.
Check that every returned face belongs to the resolved body; return body_binding.
Do not measure, select, rename, or repair any face in this atom.
rejection_rules: Reject an ambiguous/stale body reference or a face collection containing another body's faces.
Reject reuse of a pre-topology-mutation collection.
Do not infer face count or semantic feature type from this enumeration alone.
